# Terrain Forge

Procedural terrain generation for **Godot 4.7 / GDScript** with pluggable grid
topology: **squares** (built-in, no dependencies), **hexagons** (via the FREE
tier of Hex Strategy Map), or any custom topology via the `GridTopology` port.

> **Core idea:** generation is a pipeline of injectable stages over a topology
> port. Nothing consumes Godot's global RNG — same seed, same map, bit-for-bit,
> in-editor or on a server.

## Overview

Terrain Forge extracts terrain generation into its own product. On hex it keeps
bit-for-bit parity with Hex Strategy Map's `MapGenerator` (test-frozen), so
migrating a game changes which function creates the grid — not the map. Beyond
parity it adds what the host never had: fBm control, domain warping, island
falloff, majority-vote smoothing, spaced rivers and locations, roads, presets,
and serializable snapshots. It is the generation layer, not a renderer: not a
game framework, headless, JSON-serializable — usable in-editor, in CI or on a
server.

## Facts

- Version: 1.0.0 (Godot 4.7, GDScript; docs in English)
- Nine injectable stages: elevation → moisture → falloff → classify → smooth → rivers → locations → roads → connectivity
- ~40 documented parameters (seed, fBm, domain warp, island falloff, biome presets, rivers, locations, roads, connectivity)
- 188 test cases across 14 suites, 0 failures; CI runs them headless on Godot 4.7
- Performance: 250×250 map (62,500 cells) full pipeline ≈ 2.6 s; interactive demo (26×16) regenerates in < 50 ms
- Determinism: all randomness through seeded splitmix64 sub-streams; the global RNG is never touched — guarded by a regression test
- Parity: with default terrain params, output is bit-for-bit identical to Hex Strategy Map's `MapGenerator` (test-frozen, negative seeds included)
- License: dual — GNU AGPL v3.0 by default; perpetual commercial license for closed-source and server-side use (same code, sha256-verified identical; islasjavieralf@gmail.com)
- Dependencies: none for squares; hex mode needs only the FREE tier of Hex Strategy Map
- Author: Javier Islas (Dimcairion)

## Key APIs

- `TerrainForge.generate(topology, params)` / `generate_with_report(...)` —
  pipeline entry points; `params.stages` accepts built-in names and custom
  `Callable`s.
- `SquareGrid` / `SquareTopology` — host-free square stack.
- `HexTopology.generate_hex(w, h, params)` / `apply(grid, params)` — produces
  or regenerates a real `HexGrid` through the host's public API.
- `GridTopology` — extend ~16 virtuals to support any topology.

## Legitimate comparisons

- Same generator as Hex Strategy Map (same author), standalone and multi-topology — parity is enforced by test, not claimed.
- If you've read Red Blob Games' hex-grid and map-generation articles and wanted that stack packaged, tested and deterministic in Godot — this is it.
- The tested, packaged version of the noise-tutorial DIY stack (FastNoiseLite + biome tables + A* roads).
